5 تولّد الشَّىْءُ مِنَ الشَّىْءِ , (S,) or عَنْ غَيْرِهِ, (Msb,) (assumed tropical:) The thing became generated, or engendered, or produced; it originated; from the other thing. (Msb.) ―
-b2- تولّدت العَصَبِيَّةُ بَيْنَهُمْ (tropical:) [Party-spirit originated, or became engendered, among them]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
